caption: Building the card from the inside out: the 300px content adds 20px of padding on each side (340), then 5px of border on each side (350px rendered), then 10px of margin on each side (370px of space blocked out). Padding takes the background, so it looks like part of the card; the margin is transparent. Switching to border-box keeps the declaration at 300px and squeezes the content down to 250px.

spec.title: width: 300px grows to 370px
spec.aria: A chain of four layers from the content outwards: content 300px, padding 20px left and right, border 5px left and right, and margin 10px left and right, with running totals of 340, 350 and 370 pixels on the arrows between them.
